works.title: Project 2030
works.description: A counter-manifesto to Project 2025 that reverses the Heritage Foundation's conservative policy blueprint by presenting progressive, utopian correctives framed around altruistic principles, livable outcomes, and systemic justice rather than elite extraction and institutional capture.
works.quote: With AI assistance, would it only take a couple of hours to completely reverse that and make a project 2030 that basically does the opposite of 2025 in every way?
